projection_contract.source_revision_rule: Record the exact observed source commit/tree and a deterministic source-scope fingerprint. A tracked projection cannot name its containing commit without a hash cycle. check recomputes current HEAD/tree and source scope, verifies the recorded revision exists and has the same declared source scope, and reports exact current HEAD separately.
permitted_exclusions: immutable validation/review evidence added after source validation
projection_contract.exclusion_limit: Every exclusion is explicit and reasoned; governance, implementation, tests, schemas and authoritative dossier inputs may never be excluded. Evidence hashes are independently validated; a new evidence-only commit is not a semantic source change.
projection_contract.ledger_binding: Read-only direct live ledger verification at the explicit configured root; no copied tasks/roster/events; differing or missing hashes make projection stale.

compatibility_dispositions.authority: Maintenance dispositions owned by this adoption crosswalk only; these records do not change the named runtime, evidence, decision, permission or task owners.

items.subject: Hash-pinned sealed-v1 harness inheritance
items.reason: The local v2 adapter uses reviewed sealed lifecycle/evidence primitives; the sealed import is pinned to SHA-256 226a4a14b3a795b24354eb90e51a50067fd27fe809423b30b9fa1551f3ce72d6.
items.risk: Native consolidation could alter denial, receipt, lease or recovery behavior without a practical ordinary-work benefit.
items.trigger: A demonstrated behavior or maintenance defect in the inherited boundary, not stylistic cleanup.
required_proof: Complete v1/v2 behavior and denial equivalence
Unchanged receipt/evidence replay
Targeted retirement negatives and exact independent T1 review
items.recovery: Retain the reviewed adapter and exact sealed bytes; a future forward candidate must define recovery before retiring the import.

items.subject: Default .texenda state location before binding only
items.reason: The backward-compatible default supports pre-binding fixtures and historical bootstrap. Active bound Texenda requires its explicit external state root and rejects default initialization or a competing store.
items.risk: Removing the default without a reviewed forward migration would break old recovery/fixture consumers; allowing it after binding would create competing state.
items.trigger: All pre-binding consumers have a reviewed replacement and a concrete reason to remove compatibility.
required_proof: Default-before-binding positive tests
Missing/wrong explicit root and competing-state negative tests
No implicit initialization or new ledger
items.recovery: Continue using the explicit bound command; never recreate repo/.texenda/state.json.

items.subject: Four receipt-referenced ignored compatibility inputs
items.reason: Live retained receipts/evidence still resolve these exact canonical repository-relative paths and bytes. They contain no active ledger or locks after cutover.
items.risk: Moving or rewriting them invalidates receipt/evidence replay even when a copy exists elsewhere.
items.trigger: A separately reviewed forward reference migration can preserve every historical reference without rewriting the existing chain.
required_proof: Exact retained input hashes and receipt replay
No second active state store
Independent T1 approval of any forward reference migration
items.recovery: Restore only verified original bytes at the retained exact paths from authorized checkpoints; never rewrite receipts to fit missing evidence.

items.subject: Relocation helper and activation records
items.reason: The helper retains tested interruption/activation recovery; the immutable relocation receipt locates the active binding, moving descriptor and completion transaction in local/logs/workspace-relocation/.
items.risk: Archive relocation or helper removal could make an interrupted activation ambiguous and tempt unsafe initialization.
items.trigger: A future authorized location change or an actual interrupted activation requires this maintenance route.
required_proof: Non-overwriting, no-copy move and recovery negatives
Observed runtime/lease stop before mutation
Exact activation-record and state-chain verification
items.recovery: Use the helper's explicit verify/recover/rollback procedure after T1 review and runtime stop; ordinary validation never invokes its writers.

items.subject: Absolute canonical repository/state binding
items.reason: The ignored descriptor binds one canonical repository and one external state root. The visible explicit option prevents hidden selection, symlink bridges or fallback.
items.risk: Another workstation/path requires reviewed rebinding; silently inferring paths can select the wrong ledger.
items.trigger: An authorized workspace move or new-machine recovery changes a canonical location.
required_proof: Independent repository/state-root validation
Symlink, traversal, missing-state and competing-root negatives
Same receipt chain and private-input exclusion
items.recovery: Keep the existing binding until a reviewed serial move verifies the new location; fail closed on mismatch.

items.subject: Origin-v2 predecessor
items.reason: The v3 origin record hashes its v2 schema predecessor and distinguishes current selected reference, failed clean qualification, and dirty observation.
items.risk: Deleting or editing v2 erases a checked provenance link; treating v2 as current mixes clean and dirty source facts.
items.trigger: A later reviewed origin schema successor is required for a genuinely changed qualification boundary.
required_proof: Exact predecessor hash
Origin-v3 constants and evidence agreement
Unknown-schema, false-adoption and changed-descriptor negatives
items.recovery: Preserve both schemas and add reviewed successors rather than replacing their history.

items.subject: Stock planner origin-v3 limitation
items.reason: The local read-only interpreter preserves the stock origin summary as an observation and separately validates Texenda v3 and all 85 mapped paths. Its ordinary self-check has no installed-skill dependency.
items.risk: A planner view could falsely become source qualification, upgrade authority or a fabricated seed.
items.trigger: Maintenance receives a fresh explicit stock 1.0.0 planner JSON observation, or repository source/path membership changes.
required_proof: Exact target/profile/version/partition checks
Strict JSON and path/symlink/private-boundary negatives
No-write tests and no source-path execution
items.recovery: Reject incompatible input and retain the current selected reference; the external upgrade blocker remains RAIDQ-0005.

items.subject: Codex config and checked example mirror
items.reason: The active file owns defaults; the example explains use and is checked for semantic equality. Direct CLI qualification remains separate from desktop profiles.
items.risk: Unverified mirror drift could misconfigure new sessions; configuration alone cannot qualify a runtime or grant permissions.
items.trigger: A supported configuration change or direct-CLI qualification task updates the active owner.
required_proof: Parsed TOML semantic equality
Exact runtime/profile qualification before CLI assignment
No secret values or unapproved model substitution
items.recovery: Keep the reviewed defaults and correct the example through the owner; never infer effective running-session settings from either file.

items.subject: Live ready command instead of a second readiness view
items.reason: The documented read-only ready command derives available work directly from the selected ledger; a tracked copied list would require refresh and introduce avoidable stale status.
items.risk: Copied readiness can outlive leases, evidence expiry or dependency changes and be mistaken for assignment permission.
items.trigger: A demonstrated repeated-use need justifies another compact generated display.
required_proof: Live ready output under explicit state root
Any future display bound to exact ledger hashes and freshness
No second task or readiness authority
items.recovery: Re-run ready against the validated live state; do not use a historical list to authorize dispatch.

items.subject: Generic scaffold omissions and functional equivalents
items.reason: All 85 intended paths have a direct/functional mapping, justified omission or deferred trigger. Generic sample restrictions are inapplicable; optional .agents packages await a recurring need. Existing authority is indexed instead of copied.
items.risk: Installing absent generic files would add duplicate task, decision, evidence, routing or product owners.
items.trigger: A concrete recurring capability need or reviewed structural-reference change, with the full current crosswalk reassessed.
required_proof: All planner paths explicitly dispositioned
No duplicate mutable concern owner
Scoped independent review for any new capability or owner
items.recovery: Keep mapped owners and omit generic files until their exact justified scope is reviewed.
